## The access rule (B-28 = b, structural)

The set's bytes never land in the repo — `tests/ops/test_held_out_relevance.py` fails if any emitted query↔id binding lands in a committed file, if any non-seal module imports the emit path, or if the descriptor carries a set row. The label travels with every metric surface (SIG-CONF-012).
